shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'revalidate|update|cache'

cd /workspace && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; cat tsconfig.json; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -0; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/; grep -n -i "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | head
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "--- tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://localhost:3123/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done echo "--- initial page:"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o -E '

No posts yet.

|

[^<]*

' ACTION_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o -E 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[0-9a-f]+"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/name="\$ACTION_ID_([0-9a-f]+)"/\1/') echo "action id: $ACTION_ID" curl -s -o /dev/null -w "action POST status: %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3123/ \ -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" \ -F "title=Hello from smoke test" -F "content=First post body" -F "\$ACTION_ID_$ACTION_ID=" echo "--- page after create:"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o -E '

No posts yet.

|

[^<]*

' pkill -f "next start -p 3123"; tail -5 /tmp/next.log

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://localhost:3123/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done echo "--- initial page:"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o -E '

No posts yet.

|

[^<]*

' ACTION_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o -E 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[0-9a-f]+"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/name="\$ACTION_ID_([0-9a-f]+)"/\1/') curl -s -o /tmp/action.html -w "action POST status: %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3123/ \ -F "title=Hello from smoke test" -F "content=First post body" -F "\$ACTION_ID_$ACTION_ID=" echo "--- action response render:"; grep -o -E '

No posts yet.

|

[^<]*

' /tmp/action.html echo "--- fresh GET after create:"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o -E '

No posts yet.

|

[^<]*

' pkill -f "next start -p 3123"; grep -i -E "error|⨯" /tmp/next.log || echo "no server errors"
grep -i -E "error|⨯" /tmp/next.log || echo "no server errors"; git -C /workspace status --short
